messages:
lina: Heads-up — Obsidian support team has asked for temporary access to session replay logs to triage a production bug for customer ACME. They want session_id, page URL, console logs, and any visible user email fields. Is this OK for a 48h access window?
ajay: Can we get the exact scope they requested? especially which storage buckets / prefixes and whether they need raw logs vs redacted replay. Also: any contractual data-sharing constraints with ACME? @security?
morgan: If we do this, we should limit to a scoped role and auto-revoke after 48h. Redact emails and IPs, and strip full cookies. Suggest: only `replays/prod/acme/*` prefix, and `read-only-replay` role.
lina: Here's what they sent as an example request: "We need access to replays for session_id 8d7f..., plus console logs for that session. We'll only use it to reproduce a JS error and will delete after." Want to propose the exact redaction steps.
ajay: Proposed minimal policy: 1) deny access to user PII in metadata, 2) allow session-level replay frames + console logs, 3) mask emails with regex, 4) audit logging + notify ACME success contact if access granted.
morgan: Config snippet for the role we can create:
```json
{
  "role": "read-only-replay",
  "resources": ["replays/prod/acme/*"],
  "actions": ["replay.view", "logs.view"],
  "conditions": {"redact": ["email", "ip_address", "cookie"], "expiry": "48h"}
}
```
lina: That looks good. @sec-bot can you run the quick policy check and confirm there's no contractual block? Also want to ensure KMS keys aren't exposed to vendor.
sec-bot: Automated check: no enterprise contract opt-out found for ACME, KMS not shared by default. Recommend manual review for email redaction implementation and an access ticket in PAM. Link: https://redwood.internal/security/tools/policy-check :white_check_mark:
vendor-team: We can accept a scoped role and 48h expiry. We only need console logs and replay frames — we will not persist any PII. Can you provide a one-time access link or an IAM user?
ajay: Give them a short-lived IAM session (no long-lived creds). Create ticket ENG-5421 with role assignment + attach audit watch, and record the approver. I'll take ownership for the rollout.
morgan: I'll add the redaction lambda to the replay pipeline for that prefix and verify emails are masked with `/[^@\s]+@/` before granting access.
lina: Great. I'll file the request and tag @security for sign-off. If we get approval, ajay will create role and vendor-team will confirm they can access. Thanks all :thumbsup:
